_schema.what: Machine-readable TRANSCRIPTION of the ssim2-replacement exam's W1-W7 scorecard, thresholds and circularity rule, so the gauntlet board can RENDER the verdicts without re-deriving any of them. This file computes nothing. Every value is copied from the record named in `source`, and the board reads it verbatim.
_schema.source: benchmarks/ssim2_replacement_bar_2026-08-31.md — clauses §2.3, thresholds §2.4, circularity §2.1 (+ APPENDIX A.1), scorecard §3.0, amendments APPENDIX A / APPENDIX C / C ADDENDUM / C ADDENDUM 2
_schema.owner: the record above. If the record and this file disagree, the record wins and this file is the bug.
_schema.reference_row: peer_ssim2 — the control every clause is decided against; a board row backed by /mnt/v/output/zensim/reports/fulleval/peer_ssim2.fulleval.json (model.kind = reference-metric, not a bake).

circularity.excluded_reason: ssim2-ANCHORED: their targets ARE ssim2 scores, so a model's number there is agreement with ssim2, never a win over it. peer_ssim2's 1.0 is a definition, not a measurement (its own peer_provenance declares self_target:true for the first three). hf_nearlossless is the fourth, added by APPENDIX A.1: its human_score IS ssim2_gpu/100, exactly, on 1200/1200 rows — it carries no peer row and so never had to declare it. Retained as not-worse-than SANITY rows only.
circularity.train_eq_val_reason: 100% train==val for models trained on them — integrity guards, never ranking signal. TID is additionally retired to train-only by user ruling 2026-08-29 (registry tid-retired-to-train-2026-08-29).
circularity.held_out_note: KonJND on the JPEG-504 ruler. Plus the dial, speed and HDR rows. The non-circular near-lossless substitute is hfnl_cid22band (top MOS band of CID22).

thresholds.ladder_bar: ssim2's own measured value: 0.9930 pooled material monotonicity, 0% ends-backwards at q>=85
thresholds.speed_bar: >= 1.0x fast-ssim2 at 1 thread; AMENDMENT B2 redirects it to <= 1.25x the add156_156basic 156-walk class at 1T and 8T
thresholds.note: All derived, none chosen. IMPORTANT: the board's own srocc_ci (±0.006) is a PAIR bootstrap and understates the reference-clustered half-width by ~2x — 4,292 CID22 pairs are 49 clusters, not 4,292 draws.

clauses.question: not worse than peer_ssim2 by more than delta_corpus on EVERY held-out human corpus, pooled (R1) and within-image (R2)
strictly better (paired 95% CI excludes zero) on >= K=2 of those axes, at least one of them CID22 or the near-lossless zone
pooled material monotonicity >= ssim2's AND share of near-lossless ladders that END backwards <= ssim2's
>= fast-ssim2 at the shipping profile, 1 thread, same images in the same process
>= ssim2's integrated-PU path on the human HDR anchor by >= delta_upiq, with the ssim2 row measured in the SAME run
S1-S3 not collapsed (>= 0.85) and the claim made from no axis whose target is an ssim2 score
the winning bytes are loadable by a DEFAULT build

W2.note: 2 wins, neither named; ties on the near-lossless band (APPENDIX A.4). On the non-circular hfnl_cid22band it TIES ssim2: -0.0070 pooled [-0.043,+0.023], -0.0038 within-image [-0.016,+0.010]
1 win — and it IS the named one: near-lossless band, within-image +0.0151 (APPENDIX A.4)

W3.note: not measured on a shared grid

W1.note: not in the §3.0 table — carried separately for the HDR row (§3.5)

W5.note: +0.049 over ssim2-PU — the only W5 PASS anywhere in the exam

headline: NOBODY PASSES. The closest is W10L9PH_s4004_packed, which fails W1 on one axis by -0.027 and fails W2's naming clause. Separately, shipped BHdr clears W5 (+0.049 over ssim2-PU) and is not in the scorecard table at all.
amendments: APPENDIX A (2026-09-01): W2's near-lossless clause did not fail for an instrument gap — the corpus it named is an ssim2 SELF-TARGET (human_score IS ssim2_gpu/100 on 1200/1200 rows), so the opponent scores 1.0 there by construction at any feature width and no extraction could have closed it. Re-measured on the non-circular hfnl_cid22band, W10L9PH TIES and Q7b picks up one strict named win. W2 still FAILS; the reason is now measured and structural.
APPENDIX C (2026-09-01): the a4bkon closure — all three KonJND levers failed (K1 -0.0855/-0.0804, K2 wash, K3 -0.0774) and nothing passes W1-W7.
APPENDIX C ADDENDUM (2026-09-02, Profile-D no-tax lane): W4's 'one measured exception' (8T at 1152²) does NOT reproduce.

APPENDIX C ADDENDUM 2 (2026-09-04, fastclass lane): A4b's headline numbers are its BEST of three seeds, and the a4bkon ranking was a single-seed-control artifact. A4b's composite mean over k=3 is 0.8572, BELOW the 944-class teacher's 0.8601 — so the APPENDIX C headline 'higher than the teacher itself' does not survive replication. See registry seed-group-single-draw-2026-09-04.
